Create a reviews section displaying positive highlights ('Delicious and fresh food', 'Cozy and trendy atmosphere', 'Good for students and families') and constructive feedback ('Cheese quantity concern', 'Delivery service issues', 'Some pricing feedback') with a layout for professional owner responses.
Implement mobile-responsive design ensuring all sections (hero, business details, menu categories, reviews) adapt properly to small screens.
Implement SEO optimization including proper meta tags, semantic HTML structure, heading hierarchy, and descriptive content for local search visibility targeting Jammu and Kashmir location.

Apply a modern, cozy, and trendy visual design throughout the website using warm red, yellow, and cream color palette with contemporary typography and layout patterns that appeal to students, families, tourists, groups, and solo diners.

Replace the current warm red, yellow, and cream color palette with a sophisticated professional restaurant color scheme using deep charcoal (#2C2C2C), elegant gold accents (#D4AF37), crisp white (#FFFFFF), and soft off-white (#F8F6F3) for backgrounds. Update all CSS custom properties in frontend/index.css and frontend/tailwind.config.js to reflect the new professional palette.

Update typography to use elegant serif headings (Playfair Display or Cormorant Garamond) for restaurant name and section titles, paired with clean sans-serif body text (Inter or Source Sans Pro) for menu items and descriptions. Ensure font weights and sizes create a clear visual hierarchy appropriate for upscale dining.

Redesign the Hero component (frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx) with a more refined layout: use a darker overlay on the background image for better text contrast, add subtle gold accent borders or dividers, increase whitespace around elements, and ensure the contact cards have an elegant card design with soft shadows and refined spacing.

Refine the MenuSection and MenuCategory components (frontend/src/components/MenuSection.tsx, frontend/src/components/MenuCategory.tsx) to use a more upscale presentation: add subtle borders and dividers in gold, increase spacing between menu items, use refined card backgrounds with subtle shadows, and ensure price typography is elegant and clear with proper alignment.

Update the BusinessDetails component (frontend/src/components/BusinessDetails.tsx) with a more sophisticated design: use subtle gold icons, refined card layouts with elegant borders, professional star rating display, and ensure service badges have an upscale appearance with proper spacing and refined styling.

Redesign the ReviewsSection component (frontend/src/components/ReviewsSection.tsx) with professional styling: use elegant card layouts for reviews with subtle shadows, refined typography for customer feedback, gold accent elements for star ratings, and ensure owner responses are visually distinguished with professional formatting and appropriate spacing.

Update the ExtraCharges component (frontend/src/components/ExtraCharges.tsx) with refined table styling: use subtle borders in gold or charcoal, elegant header row styling, proper spacing between rows and columns, and ensure the pricing table has a clean, professional appearance consistent with upscale restaurant menus.

Refine the Footer component (frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx) with professional styling: use charcoal background with gold accents, elegant typography for contact information, proper spacing and alignment, and ensure all footer elements are visually balanced and consistent with the upscale restaurant theme.

Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, links, hover states) use refined professional styling: subtle gold hover effects, smooth transitions, elegant focus states with gold outlines, and proper contrast ratios for accessibility while maintaining the upscale aesthetic.

Increase the opacity of the dark overlay on the hero background image in frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx to improve text readability. The current gradient overlay is not providing sufficient contrast for the white text and gold elements to be clearly visible against the background image.

Change hero section text colors to dark in frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx for improved visibility. Update location text, phone number, and hours text from their current light colors to dark charcoal colors that contrast well against the background overlay. Ensure all text in contact cards remains clearly readable.

Update restaurant rating from 3.7 to 4.5 in frontend/src/components/BusinessDetails.tsx. Change the displayed rating value while maintaining the same review count (36 reviews) and star rating display formatting.

Change hero section text colors in frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx to match the gold icon color (#D4AF37). Update the location text, phone number text, and hours text in the contact cards to use the same gold color as the icons for visual consistency.

Create a new ReservationSection component (frontend/src/components/ReservationSection.tsx) with a section titled 'Reserve Your Table'. Include a professional booking form with the following required fields: Full Name (text input, required), Mobile Number (text input, required), Email Address (text input, optional), Number of Guests (dropdown 1-20, required), Reservation Date (date picker, required), Reservation Time (time picker, required), Occasion (dropdown with options: Birthday, Anniversary, Casual Visit, Party, Other; required), and Special Request (textarea, optional). Use elegant styling consistent with the restaurant's charcoal and gold theme.

Add a bold red 'Reserve Now' button with a pointing emoji (👉) to the reservation form in ReservationSection component. Implement form validation that checks all required fields (Full Name, Mobile Number, Number of Guests, Reservation Date, Reservation Time, Occasion) are filled before submission. Display clear error messages for any missing required fields.

Implement WhatsApp integration in the ReservationSection component. When the 'Reserve Now' button is clicked and form validation passes, generate a pre-filled WhatsApp message with all customer details formatted as: 'Hello Perfetto Pizza Plus,

New Table Reservation Request:

Name: [Customer Name]
Mobile: [Customer Number]
Email: [Customer Email]
Guests: [Number of Guests]
Date: [Selected Date]
Time: [Selected Time]
Occasion: [Selected Occasion]
Special Request: [Message]

Please confirm my reservation. Thank you.' Open WhatsApp Web or WhatsApp app with this pre-filled message directed to the phone number +919797957878 using the WhatsApp API URL format (https://wa.me/919797957878?text=).

Create a FloatingWhatsAppButton component (frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsAppButton.tsx) that displays a floating button fixed at the bottom-right corner of the website with the text 'Chat With Us on WhatsApp'. When clicked, it should open a direct WhatsApp chat with the phone number +919797957878 using the WhatsApp API URL (https://wa.me/919797957878). Style the button with green WhatsApp brand colors, appropriate spacing from edges (e.g., 24px), a WhatsApp icon, subtle shadow, and ensure it remains visible and accessible on mobile devices.

Add the ReservationSection component to the main App component (frontend/src/App.tsx) after the MenuSection and before the ExtraCharges component. Also add the FloatingWhatsAppButton component at the end of the App component so it appears globally across all sections.
